scope: All 16 manifest capabilities reviewed for Linux applicability; 325 desktop requirements classified and 20 mobile-only requirements explicitly outside Linux scope. Counts measure candidate behavior, not completion percentage or release acceptance.

classification_rules.implemented: Candidate Linux behavior has automated production-path evidence; does not approve release, parity or human qualification.
classification_rules.partial: Some production behavior/evidence exists; full normative Linux requirement remains incomplete.
classification_rules.not-started: No native user flow found for the requirement; related generic helpers are insufficient.
classification_rules.blocked: Work requires the named human decision; underlying implementation status remains visible in the trace.
classification_rules.not-applicable: Explicitly outside Linux desktop scope, not a platform waiver.

outside_linux_scope.reason: SPEC Scope and relationship to desktop declares Android and iOS only. No mobile completion is claimed.

classification_changes.reason: Maintainer-approved EDITOR-SESSION-001 0.2.1 keeps the nine ES-029 diagnostics closed and carries value-free rejection reasons separately. parseDocument and parseAnnotationList map traversal and unsafe content to document-invalid; readXann maps malformed/duplicate-key/encoding failures to document-invalid and lexical depth/element/size limits to document-too-large. Unknown future JSON-boundary failures fall back to document-invalid, never a constructed public code. Validation, per-record rejection findings and persisted XANN bytes remain unchanged. Version then size then invalid precedence is covered by native tests and four new vectors. LoadedSource carries the reason; standalone Open and replacement show a localized diagnostic, a separate Rejected document reason and the import report, preserving raster/sidecar bytes and omitting payload values. Both Qt 6.12 and Qt 6.4.2 pass XannCompatibilityTest, EditorSessionTest, EditorSourceTest, all three EditorWindowTest partitions and all 23 conformance vectors. Prior-reader closure, old mappings and omitted native reason tests fail before the fix. This is an implemented Linux candidate; maintainer review accepted the code, contract, evidence and classification on 2026-11-13, conditional on correcting the current trace question (now resolved) and passing the rebuilt full integration gate. Target/parity/release qualification remains separate.

Screen/Region/File recognition code and real-decoder/portal tests exist, but this scheduler explicitly still prohibits QR scanning and labels zxing-cpp unapproved; preserve evidence without waiving that gate.

Supported capture, recording and upload/watch operations now use WorkflowExecution with stable IDs, start/origin/settings, ordered results and terminal projection. FileUploadController still continues to network transfer when execution admit/start or read-file-step persistence fails; one traceable durable execution is therefore not guaranteed at that boundary.

Shared file-operation failure taxonomy distinguishes validation, permission, unavailable, transient/permanent, partial and cancelled states. Watch storage failures stop new effects and retain completed output honestly. File upload still crosses admission/start/step storage failure before transfer, so durable workflow reporting at all side-effect boundaries remains incomplete.

Canonical authorized roots, readiness filtering, per-file duplicate checkpoints and owned cancellable copy/move/upload exist. However rescan recursively enumerates and stats the authorized tree on the GUI thread before checking pending work; no bounded/cancellable discovery path qualifies clean Stop for large or slow trees.

SQLite reader holds a read-only transaction and bounded backup snapshot, validates integrity and ordinary-table schema, disables extensions/views/triggers, bounds bytes/rows/time and emits typed transaction failures; WAL/concurrent writer and malicious schema tests exercise this native behavior.

Default-off, profile-local cursor inclusion now uses an owned compositor frame before the overlay. Native controller/crop/PNG integration verifies saved cursor pixels exactly once, frozen preferences, unsupported/mismatched refusal, cancellation, stale completion and owner-loss fencing. Mixed-scale/rotated/multi-output and every supported desktop remain unqualified; partial, not absent or fully implemented.

incremental_updates.outcome: Native workflow execution metadata review and confirmed unchanged-record removal are implemented and tested. Full retention and remaining capability behavior remain partial.

Native Save As offers PNG/JPEG/WebP with explicit quality, JPEG matte and extension validation. Actual worker encoding, source-preserving sidecars, format-aware repair and cancellation-boundary refusal are tested. Full codec/profile/target/fault and human qualification remain partial.

Native profile preferences expose quick confirmation and snapping with normative enabled defaults, field validation and Apply/Cancel/reset. Options freeze before portal acquisition; explicit confirmation enables existing keyboard adjustments. Interactive handles/presets, remaining fields and native target/human qualification remain partial.

Selected region corner handles are interactive with logical-coordinate hit-testing, persistent drag cursors, grab offset, Core positive-size/desktop clamps, resize announcements and explicit Enter confirmation. All corners at 1x/2x native scale and cancellation/actual output are tested. Optional presets and native target/accessibility qualification remain partial. RC-027 recapture requires an approved physical mapping source before pixel acquisition; no speculative recapture was added.

Native successful region screenshots persist version-1 geometry only through OwnedWork and PrivateJsonFile before actions. Existing malformed/newer/stale/unsafe records remain intact; compatible unknown fields round-trip. Metadata failures retain normal image outputs and stay visible even when workflow processing admission also fails. Storage and actual controller ordering/teardown/cancellation tests pass. Native recapture remains blocked on pre-acquisition physical topology authority; physical mapping/identity, crash and target qualification remain partial.

Native speech-balloon edit dialog provides asynchronous explicit commit/cancel for multiline text, font size and tail enable/tip coordinates. Existing points persist without a schema change. Tail-only edits commit once and undo/redo correctly; shared Core validation rejects invalid or overflowing mapped geometry. Regression evidence covers ignored tail changes, missing history admission for tip-only edits, and a real tiny-balloon renderer clamp assertion. State/selection/document and owner teardown tests pass. Font family/weight/italic/alignment/text color, creation/default breadth and physical qualification remain partial.

Text and speech balloons expose horizontal alignment in a shared asynchronous native text dialog. An optional per-object enum persists with legacy rendering retained when absent. Core rejects invalid creation/edit/import values, while unrelated annotation types preserve the same property opaquely. UI/history/reload and actual renderer glyph-placement tests cover both types. Font family, bold/italic, text colors, creation/default breadth and human target qualification remain partial.

Native Text and SpeechBalloon Bold/Italic controls apply optional booleans as one undoable object edit. Legacy native styling remains unchanged when absent. Core persistence refuses invalid text field types and retains opaque same-named values on unrelated families. UI/history/reload and renderer glyph tests cover both types. Font family, explicit text color, creation/default breadth and human qualification remain partial.

Native Text and SpeechBalloon text-color entry supports explicit #AARRGGBB and empty/default restoration independently of border/fill. Optional Core color persists canonically with alpha, including transparent zero; absence retains exact legacy rendering. Invalid entry/import cannot partially mutate the document. Tests cover native Apply/Cancel, no-op history, color-only undo/redo/reload, opaque fields on other types and actual alpha composition. Font family, creation/default breadth and target/human qualification remain partial.

Native Text and SpeechBalloon font-family selection preserves unavailable saved names, renders them with the unchanged native fallback, and permits explicit installed replacements or default restoration as one history edit. Optional family strings persist without touching older documents. Core validates shape string/resource boundaries and retains opaque fields on other families. Native UI/history/reload, independent Qt glyph comparison and missing-font fallback tests cover both types. Reproduced/fixed QComboBox entry truncation from 100000 to 32767 characters. Creation/default breadth and target/human qualification remain partial.

Native Text and SpeechBalloon creation now opens full formatting controls asynchronously before any document mutation. Apply creates once from pointer-down geometry/style/state/selection; Cancel and empty entry create nothing. Shared completion fences document replacement, stale/disabled/dead owners and duplicate/deferred callbacks. Tests cover creation formatting, frozen defaults, undo/redo/reload, cancellation, focus transfer and teardown. Reproduced/fixed focus loss cancelling modal creation and old completed-dialog destruction clearing later modal pending state. Saved-default authority, remaining style breadth and human target qualification remain partial.

Selected Step numbers now edit asynchronously across the existing v1 0..1000000000 range, preserving previously clamped large values. Shared persisted/create/edit numeric bounds refuse invalid mutations. Text and Step reuse one guarded dialog completion path, retaining creation focus/cancellation behavior. Native tests cover boundaries, Apply/Cancel/no-op, history/reload, stale and dead owners, duplicate completion and deferred cleanup. Reproduced native 1000000 clamping and invalid create/edit admission before fixes. Alphabetic/Roman mappings and reset semantics are blocked pending product decisions; tail, defaults and full qualification remain partial.

Blur/Pixelate/Magnify/Spotlight native strength editing now uses owned asynchronous fractional input through shared guarded completion. Eight regressions reproduced integer rounding and zero/default materialization on unchanged Apply. The dialog preserves exact saved values when unchanged, including compatible values outside current native editing ranges; explicit edits retain those existing ranges and commit once. Native tests cover precision, Cancel/history/reload, stale/dead owners and deferred cleanup. Renderer behavior, persistence schema and default policy remain unchanged; full option and target qualification remains partial.

Creation now refuses font-size and strength values rejected by the existing reader/edit boundaries before any object, state, selection or history mutation. Reproduced 35 invalid admissions before fixing; zero, fractions and maximum boundaries retain exact values through history and reload. No schema, renderer, default or contract range changes. Other options/resource and target qualification remain partial.

Native text/balloon font-size input supports doubles with 17 decimal places in the existing 1..2000 editing range. Comparing against the initialized displayed value preserves exact saved fractions and zero/default on no-op Apply, including compatible values below the native minimum. Reproduced two native .125-to-1 regressions; tests cover fractional/high-precision edits, Cancel/no-op, one history step, undo/redo/reload and source preservation. No renderer, schema, saved-default or reader-range changes. Remaining text border/fill and target qualification remain partial.

Native Text/SpeechBalloon have optional per-object alpha-preserving fill input during creation and selected editing. Absent values retain exact legacy fill/fallback rendering; explicit transparent zero stays distinct and clearing restores legacy. Strict parsing/canonical writing applies only to these families, keeping same-named opaque fields on other and unknown types. Native UI, creation/history/reload and independent opaque/half/zero-alpha rendering tests cover the real path. Two missing-control failures and six ignored-fill pixel failures were reproduced before implementation. Border and full target qualification remain partial.

Asset-free annotation selections can copy/cut from image-bearing documents without publishing unselected embedded images. A shared private-v1 clipboard guard refuses incoming and outgoing Image/Emoji/Cursor references, including absent-pixel offers; local duplication keeps assets and one history step. Seven Core baseline failures reproduced the incorrect document-wide block and dangling references. Native clipboard/cut/undo/save/reopen tests retain actual unselected PNG assets. Transport shape/version, resource bounds and validation precedence are unchanged; full asset-bearing clipboard transport remains partial. The headless GUI fixture publishes actual Qt MIME data with an explicitly acknowledged test port; production ownership/unknown-delivery guards are unchanged, and physical ownership qualification remains open.

Native SpeechBalloon creation/editing now supports an independent optional #AARRGGBB border override, including transparent zero; absence/clearing preserves the original stroke-color rule. Body and tail share the existing outline geometry. Five baseline failures reproduced the missing native control, ignored opaque/half/zero-alpha outline pixels and invalid import admission. EditorCanvasTest covers Apply/Cancel/no-op/invalid input, one history step, undo/redo/reload, immutable source, retained text/fill/tail fields, canonical clipboard round-trip, actual creation and independent source-over export pixels. The field is typed only for SpeechBalloon; Text/other/unknown families retain same-named opaque data. Regular Text border geometry, other tool options and physical/human qualification remain partial.

CaptureActions replaces its buffer-only temporary.file with a real owner-private PNG consumed by path and removed by default engine cleanup or executor teardown. Saved-file precedence, success/failure/cancel cleanup and independent action continuation have native tests.

The editor now has native Pin to Screen and Upload Image actions. Upload confirms a frozen configured destination, exposes progress/cancellation, keeps the document on failures and displays a selectable/copyable result URL. Pin remains partial pending approved service/desktop qualification.

User-approved local ZXing QR scanning and Tesseract English OCR are reachable through native Image File/Screen/Region tool windows, with explicit Copy and owned cancellation/session cleanup. Dependency-absent and missing-model failures are explicit.

Saved capture workflows now run local OCR/QR and explicit OCR clipboard through existing ordered worker/GUI pipeline. Empty OCR leaves clipboard unchanged; recognition values are omitted from durable receipts and journals. Retained metadata does not authorize recognition retry.

Concurrent quick-task implementation 94ae69d retained during rebase. Additional private-bus PortalScreenshotTest evidence exercises a configured quick-task workflow through the real CaptureController: acquired region pixels reach the native chooser, run-only Save replaces the configured clipboard choice, an actual PNG is published, the effective plan is journaled, and borrowed source bytes plus the original workflow snapshot remain unchanged. This complements the concurrently landed native selector implementation; physical desktop qualification remains open.

FileUploadController stops before HTTP if execution admission, start or read-file persistence fails. executionStorageFailurePreventsUpload reproduced one POST per failed write before the fix and zero afterward. Existing acknowledged-upload terminal-storage failure behavior is retained. The earlier source-extracted finding is resolved for this boundary; the historical audit is retained and the requirement stays partial pending complete qualification.

Recursive watch discovery now runs on one owned worker; repeated scan requests coalesce. Held-enumeration evidence proves GUI event delivery, cancellation, changed rule/capture-folder rejection, safe owner destruction and rediscovery of retained sources. Existing readiness, exclusions, duplicate checkpoints and copy/move/upload result tests wait for completed observations without weakening their assertions. The earlier synchronous-discovery finding is resolved for enumeration; watcher registration, final candidate identity checks, checkpoint I/O and unknown-publication restart policy remain separate.

Candidate recovery cleanup preserves protected records, refuses new recovery at protected capacity and still allows updates above capacity. Cleanup follows successful publication. Restore now adopts its selected id and expected snapshot, leaving all seven other deferred files unchanged in the eight-record crash-leftover regression. Failed/changed takeover preserves bytes and the editor retains its own optimistic-write snapshot for future updates/removal. Maintainer accepted protected-capacity refusal and narrowing the existing count bound, requested the now-fixed takeover defect, and approved corrected candidate 8bfd4a9 subject to the full integration gate. A known snapshot currently blocks recreation of an externally removed recovery file; safe recreation remains a follow-up with explicit-save guidance meanwhile. Configured retention, PID namespaces and worker-owned recovery I/O remain pending.

Editor recovery serialization, storage, removal, pruning and restart listing now run through one process-owned FIFO on OwnedWork. Autosaves return immediately and coalesce queued writes by record; Save/Discard removes pending writes and orders removal after any running write. Close and explicit writes wait through a Qt event loop, and shutdown drains the queue. Window destruction leaves started writes to finish without delivering into the dead window. Native held-worker tests cover GUI timers, a second canvas edit reaching the latest snapshot, Save/Discard cleanup, owner destruction, two editors and corrupt-file startup listing. Existing takeover and lifecycle rules remain unchanged.  Maintainer review found signal-triggered QApplication::exit can interrupt nested close waits. The application now drains recovery again after exec returns, preserving explicit Discard even during SIGTERM/SIGINT. Subprocess tests first failed with a surviving recovery file for both signals when that drain was omitted; both pass with the real termination handler and post-loop drain. Claude Opus maintainer approved composed candidate 74ec3a9..2caab22 on 2026-11-13, subject to the rebuilt full 181-target integration gate before push.

Maintainer-approved EDITOR-SESSION-001 0.2.1 keeps the nine ES-029 diagnostics closed and carries value-free rejection reasons separately. parseDocument and parseAnnotationList map traversal and unsafe content to document-invalid; readXann maps malformed/duplicate-key/encoding failures to document-invalid and lexical depth/element/size limits to document-too-large. Unknown future JSON-boundary failures fall back to document-invalid, never a constructed public code. Validation, per-record rejection findings and persisted XANN bytes remain unchanged. Version then size then invalid precedence is covered by native tests and four new vectors. LoadedSource carries the reason; standalone Open and replacement show a localized diagnostic, a separate Rejected document reason and the import report, preserving raster/sidecar bytes and omitting payload values. Both Qt 6.12 and Qt 6.4.2 pass XannCompatibilityTest, EditorSessionTest, EditorSourceTest, all three EditorWindowTest partitions and all 23 conformance vectors. Prior-reader closure, old mappings and omitted native reason tests fail before the fix. This is an implemented Linux candidate; maintainer review accepted the code, contract, evidence and classification on 2026-11-13, conditional on correcting the current trace question (now resolved) and passing the rebuilt full integration gate. Target/parity/release qualification remains separate.

Maintainer decision, 2026-11-14: external deletion is not an explicit Discard of a running dirty editor. Its next ordinary write recreates the private recovery record under the same id. A locked Missing read uses an empty expected snapshot, while the writer keeps its cached ownership snapshot until publication succeeds. Recreation still passes new-record capacity/pruning admission; protected capacity refuses without changing other files. Changed supported, newer, corrupt and linked intervening files are preserved. Store and native tests cover latest-document recreation, subsequent updates/removal, refusal at protected capacity followed by a foreign replacement, four intervening-file cases, and Save/Undo/Discard after recreation. The original store/native regressions fail before the fix; preservation cases stay green. The rebuilt probe succeeds with subsequent_write=ok and exists=1. No watcher, queue/lifetime change, new retention threshold or contract change. Claude Opus maintainer and independent MiniMax Code reviewer approved candidate 4010535 on 2026-11-14. The rebuilt 181-target gate passed after one isolated capture-recognition rerun, and the unchanged source was pushed as fdc728f. This approval covers the bounded recreation/preservation change; broader retention, PID-namespace and release qualification remain open.

Watch-folder processed checkpoints now freeze inputs on the GUI thread and serialize/re-read/atomically publish through OwnedWork. Completion is reported only after save or explicit checkpoint failure; no next file dispatches while pending. Stop does not cancel an already-earned checkpoint; owner destruction drops only adoption, retaining the worker write. The post-exec drain waits for completion, including signal exits; a conflicting writer or failed write blocks watching without adoption or retry. GUI-thread watcher registration remains accepted because QFileSystemWatcher owns its thread-bound inotify watches; the final one-file fingerprint remains accepted to refuse replacement immediately before dispatch. Rule persistence, execution-record writes, settings transfer/import/migration and other storage boundaries remain separate. Unknown-publication restart policy and checkpoint retention remain open; CORE-025 stays partial. Held-worker tests pass for settle, Stop/Start, destruction, drain and writer conflict on Qt 6.12 and Qt 6.4.2. The synchronous-path mutation fails the new responsiveness case. Both original suites passed twenty repetitions on Qt 6.12 and Qt 6.4.2. Option B approved after test hardening; the full gate remains required before push. Maintainer accepts the rest of 81fe180 and requested Option B: the worker returns its completed processed set for move-adoption, avoiding GUI-thread copying/rehashing; final old-set release on the GUI thread is accepted. The core adoption test now inserts a worker-only marker into the returned set and asserts it survives adoption; restoring insert(write.key) fails that assertion, and move-adoption passes. The stale-snapshot guard remains covered; Option B approved after test hardening. Both original watch suites passed twenty repetitions on each Qt baseline.

Settings export/import, previous-app inspection/migration, backup revision/probe, restore and dismiss now run through one dialog-owned OwnedWork lane with copied paths/plans only. Busy covers picker, inspection, preview and publication; transfer/Apply/OK/reset re-entry is disabled, and late picker rejection after selection does not end the operation. Confirmed commits ignore ordinary dialog completion and disable Cancel until live store adoption and callbacks finish. ApplicationSettingsStore is loaded on the worker and moved into the GUI-owned store; existing refresh, shortcut invalidation, imported and applied callbacks retain owner fencing and order. Before commit, close/cancel drops delivery; a confirmed commit continues after forced owner deletion without callbacks, either completing atomically on disk or using existing startup recovery. App quit is not intercepted and no new exit mechanism is introduced. GUI-side imported callbacks still reload editor/workflow settings and remain a separate follow-up. Persisted formats, transaction fences, source preservation, backups, secret omission and the 8MiB input bound are unchanged. Native tests cover asynchronous stage boundaries, all five busy transfer controls, picker rejection/destruction, preview cancellation, commit-close refusal, teardown in inspect/preview/commit, and backup enablement. Synchronous commit mutation fails the immediate-publication and owner-teardown assertions. Candidate: maintainer and independent threading/import review plus full gate pending; statuses stay partial and coverage174/324 unchanged.

audit_method: All 16 capabilities and 345 IDs revalidated. Existing unchanged source/test behavior was compared to frozen reviewed evidence, changed production paths and meaningful test bodies inspected, and exact current hashes/method lines repinned. 325 desktop rows remain conservative candidate classifications; 20 MOB rows remain outside desktop scope.

Typed error code/token/scalar-offset behavior is covered for supported contexts; %rf still omits eligible lines after the first 256, contrary to selecting among all nonempty lines.
